title: Transport sidecar exits on S3 credential errors at startup and takes the Kanidm primary out of its Service

source.reference: v0.24.1 live backup review (campaign plan #1207), findings F3B.19 and F4A.8: a repository whose writer lacked s3:ListBucket, or whose credentials were invalid, made the data-mover-transport native sidecar exit 1 on the startup backfill listing (403 AccessDenied / InvalidAccessKeyId). The sidecar crashlooped (Init:CrashLoopBackOff), the primary pod went Ready=False/ContainersReady=False and left the EndpointSlice, a full IdM outage with one replica, while the Schedule and repository stayed Ready=True.

required_properties: On the primary, transport startup steps that depend on S3, the network or credentials (S3 client creation and the startup manifest listing) are retried in-process with capped exponential backoff instead of exiting

Retryable, authorization and missing-credential failures never end the process, and invalid configuration that the webhook can admit (for example a scheme-less endpoint) never crashloops the sidecar either: it is logged clearly and not retried
Shutdown (SIGTERM/SIGINT) during a startup backoff or while waiting for the watch directory ends the process cleanly and promptly
Every retry is logged with the failing step, the attempt and the next delay

The retry logic is unit-tested with an injected failing async closure, covering retry-until-success with the backoff sequence, no exit on authorization errors, immediate return on InvalidInput, and shutdown during backoff
The statefulset.rs comment no longer claims the native sidecar does not participate in Pod readiness
An e2e test proves a primary whose repository has invalid credentials stays Ready and its transport sidecar has zero restarts
forbidden_changes: Hiding the failure by removing the startup listing or by treating a failed listing as an empty known-backup set
Adding a readiness probe or any other change that claims to exclude the native sidecar from Pod readiness instead of keeping it running
Retrying forever on InvalidInput, or exiting on any credential, S3 or admitted-configuration error
A retry loop that ignores shutdown or blocks the Tokio runtime
Editing restore Job code under libs/operator/src/kanidm/restore/
